mapper.sql: id, access_code, name, scope_type, scope_id, scope_name, status, creator_id, creator_name, total_count, normal_count, profit_count, loss_count, abnormal_count, pending_diff_count, remark, create_time, finish_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory_task( access_code, name, scope_type, scope_id, scope_name, status, creator_id, creator_name, total_count, normal_count, profit_count, loss_count, abnormal_count, remark, create_time, finish_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{accessCode}, #{name}, #{scopeType}, #{scopeId}, #{scopeName}, #{status}, #{creatorId}, #{creatorName}, #{totalCount}, #{normalCount}, #{profitCount}, #{lossCount}, #{abnormalCount}, #{remark}, NOW(), NULL, NOW() )
mapper.select: select from inventory_task where access_code = #{accessCode} limit 1

select from inventory_task
AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND status = #{status}
order by id desc
